title: Women's conference tied to fire anniversary
summary: In November 2024 the Committee on the Status of Women proposed a late-July women's health conference connected to the August 8 wildfire commemoration. In July 2026 it reported sponsoring the conference with a little over $5,000, inviting fire survivors free, and voting to combine Women of Excellence with a July 2027 conference.

timeline.text: Motion to combine the Women of Excellence event with the women's conference being planned for July 2027: The committee voted to combine the Women of Excellence event with the women's conference planned for July 2027.
The chair said the next women's conference is intended for July, right before the anniversary of the fires.
The chair said another women's conference is in the committee's budget.
The chair said video from the women's conference will be shared at or before the August meeting.
The vice chair opened day two of the conference with a disaster preparedness presentation for the Maui Emergency Management Agency.
The chair said inviting fire survivors helped with their healing and gathered their responses.
Fire survivors were invited to the committee's women's conference for free.
The committee sponsored its women's conference with a little over $5,000.
She said the timing would connect to the August 8th wildfire commemoration.
